description: This Java class defines a custom exception called PolicyPreconditionFailedException, which is thrown when a precondition check on a policy resource fails. It extends a runtime exception and implements a policy exception interface, providing detailed information and builder methods for creating instances with specific error details.

classes.name: PolicyPreconditionFailedException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a precondition check on a policy resource failed, with associated headers, messages, and optional cause and links.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a PolicyPreconditionFailedException with specified header name and expected vs actual values.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyPreconditionFailedException from a given message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyPreconditionFailedException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with updated headers.
